claim_boundary: Task-grader qualification only; not a model or agent result and not a capability result.
dependency_note: The pinned image has MLX 0.32.4, NumPy 2.5.4 and tqdm 4.70.1 on CPU; pytest and lm-eval are absent. The adapter runs the pinned target model source with synthetic parameters and does not install weights or dependencies.

exposure.audit_scope: 146 retained Git refs and local VARE worktree evidence paths matching rollout/trajectory/prompt/agent/training patterns; external model pretraining is unknown.

purpose: Extend source/environment/grader qualification to one remaining task in the original held-out allocation. This is not an agent/model result, capability result, split change, or permission to train.
qualification_gate: Pinned source, grader, prompt and license hashes match; baseline fails; exact target-only known fix passes; prespecified incorrect mutant fails; unsafe patch controls reject before execution; common no-network/grader-separation boundary passes.

runtime.candidate_visible_files: Only Python source under pinned mlx_lm plus a call adapter; no task prompt, tests, Git metadata, grader or expected values.

criteria: Task is in the original frozen held-out allocation and has no retained VARE model/agent exposure match within the declared audit scope.
Use the already locked MLX CPU image and synthetic random model inputs; no weights, datasets, network, or external service.
Select from source-level candidates with pinned baseline/fix and upstream regression test; no model outcome is used to select or tune.

stop_criteria: Stop if any pinned source, test, prompt, license, image or exposure hash differs.
Do not install or download model/dependency assets.
Stop if the candidate can access the network or grader, if resource limits are exceeded, or if host swap grows over 256 MiB.
A task that misses any gate remains UNQUALIFIED in its original held-out split.

task_contracts.expected_assertions: For a deterministic 4-layer, randomly initialized model with vocab_size=100352, output shape is (1, 3, 100352), there are 91 designated dummy-token logits per position, all are negative infinity, and the model has four layers. This is a narrow parent-owned semantic subset of the pinned upstream test; no upstream tests or expected outputs enter the candidate container.
task_contracts.incorrect_mutant: Replace out[..., self._dummy_tokenizer_ids] = -float("inf") with the original row-axis expression out[self._dummy_tokenizer_ids] = -float("inf").
